title: Leo wants fireworks. Auntie says tea.
caption: Leo wants a movie love. The Aunties have been married forever and say it's not fireworks: it's small daily attention, staying curious, saying thank you and repairing after fights. Sometimes it's just a cup of tea brought without asking. Who brings you tea?
